name: Python Initiated Connection
description: Detects a Python process initiating a network connection. While this often relates to package installation, it can also indicate a potential malicious script communicating with a C&C server.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate python scripts using the socket library or similar will trigger this. Apply additional filters and perform an initial baseline before deploying.
query: (network.direction:true AND (process.executable:*\\python* AND process.executable:*.exe*)) AND (NOT ((destination.ip:127.0.0.1 AND source.ip:127.0.0.1) OR (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*pip.exe* AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*install*))) AND (NOT ((process.parent.executable:C\:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\Scripts\\conda.exe AND (winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*\:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\Scripts\\conda\-script.py* AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*update*)) OR (process.parent.executable:C\:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\python.exe AND winlog.event_data.CommandLine:*C\:\\ProgramData\\Anaconda3\\Scripts\\jupyter\-notebook\-script.py*)))
